title: Require second approval for orders over €10k
author: kemi.a
description:
## Context

Finance asked for a four-eyes check on large orders after an incident where a high-value order was placed against the wrong customer account and charged before anyone noticed. This PR makes all orders over €10,000 wait for a second person with the finance approver role before they're confirmed and the card is charged.

## Changes

- New `ApprovalPolicy`: all orders over €10,000 are saved as `PENDING_APPROVAL` instead of `CONFIRMED`.
- New `POST /orders/:id/approve`, restricted to `finance_approver`; creators can't approve their own orders.
- Approvers get an email when an order needs them.
- Payment capture still happens on `order.created`, which for large orders is now emitted after approval.
- Migration 0042 makes room for the new status value and adds `approved_by` and `approved_at`.

## Testing

Unit tests for the policy boundaries (€9,999, €10,000, €10,000.01) and self-approval. Manually tested the approve flow on staging.
